analysis_walkthrough.business_objective_summary: Modernize a legacy VB6 banking application to C#, ensuring functionality is documented, architecture is designed, services are rewritten, and the application is deployed for Docker testing.
requirements_understanding: The legacy application is a banking system with a database connection using Microsoft Jet OLEDB.
The modernization involves translating VB6 code to C# and ensuring backward compatibility.
The project requires documentation of current functionality and acceptance criteria.
Security and QA checks are mandatory before deployment.
conversion_to_technical_requirements: Use C# for rewriting the application logic and services.
Implement a service-oriented architecture to replace legacy VB6 components.
Utilize Docker for local testing and deployment.
Ensure database interactions are migrated to a modern data access strategy.
clarifications_requested: Are there any specific security standards that need to be adhered to during modernization?
Is there a preferred cloud provider for hosting the Docker containers post-local testing?

output.executive_summary: This project aims to modernize a legacy VB6 banking application to C#, ensuring all functionalities are preserved, documented, and tested for deployment in a Docker environment.

functional_requirements.title: Database Connection Service
functional_requirements.description: Implement a C# service to establish a connection to the Access database using a modern data access library.
acceptance_criteria: The service must connect to the Access database using a specified connection string.
The service must handle connection errors gracefully and log them.
The service must be testable independently using unit tests.

functional_requirements.title: Customer Data Command Service
functional_requirements.description: Develop a service to interact with the 'customer' table in the database, replacing the legacy Command1 functionality.
acceptance_criteria: The service must execute CRUD operations on the 'customer' table.
The service must validate input data before executing database commands.
The service must log all database interactions for audit purposes.

functional_requirements.title: User Interface Modernization
functional_requirements.description: Redesign the user interface in C# to replicate the existing VB6 forms and workflows.
acceptance_criteria: The new UI must replicate the functionality of Form1 and Form5.
The UI must be responsive and compatible with modern browsers.
The UI must pass usability testing with a minimum score of 80% satisfaction.

functional_requirements.title: Security and QA Checks
functional_requirements.description: Implement security and quality assurance checks for the modernized application.
acceptance_criteria: The application must pass all security checks with no critical vulnerabilities.
The application must achieve a minimum of 90% code coverage in unit tests.
All identified bugs must be resolved before deployment.

functional_requirements.title: Docker Deployment
functional_requirements.description: Deploy the modernized application in a local Docker environment for testing.
acceptance_criteria: The application must run successfully in a Docker container.
The Docker image must be built using a specified Dockerfile.
Deployment scripts must automate the setup and teardown of the Docker environment.

functional_requirements.title: Documentation of Functionality
functional_requirements.description: Document the current and modernized functionality of the application.
acceptance_criteria: All existing functionalities must be documented with clear descriptions.
The documentation must include acceptance criteria for each functionality.
The documentation must be reviewed and approved by the project stakeholders.

functional_requirements.title: Error Handling Implementation
functional_requirements.description: Implement comprehensive error handling across all services.
acceptance_criteria: All services must handle exceptions and log errors appropriately.
Error messages must be user-friendly and provide actionable information.
The error handling strategy must be documented and reviewed.

functional_requirements.title: Logging and Monitoring
functional_requirements.description: Implement logging and monitoring for the modernized application.
acceptance_criteria: All services must log key events and errors to a centralized logging system.
Monitoring dashboards must provide real-time insights into application performance.
Alerts must be configured for critical failures and performance issues.

non_functional_requirements.title: Performance
non_functional_requirements.description: Ensure the application performs efficiently under expected load.
non_functional_requirements.metric: Response time must be under 200ms for 95% of requests.
acceptance_criteria: The application must handle 1000 concurrent users without performance degradation.
Performance tests must show response times under 200ms for 95% of requests.
The application must pass load testing with a minimum throughput of 500 transactions per second.

non_functional_requirements.title: Security
non_functional_requirements.description: Ensure the application is secure against common vulnerabilities.
non_functional_requirements.metric: No critical vulnerabilities in security scans.
acceptance_criteria: The application must pass OWASP Top 10 security checks.
All data must be encrypted in transit and at rest.
Access controls must be implemented to restrict unauthorized access.

non_functional_requirements.title: Scalability
non_functional_requirements.description: Design the application to scale horizontally.
non_functional_requirements.metric: Must support scaling to 10,000 concurrent users.
acceptance_criteria: The architecture must support horizontal scaling with minimal configuration changes.
The application must maintain performance metrics when scaled to 10,000 users.
Scalability tests must demonstrate the application's ability to scale efficiently.

non_functional_requirements.title: Reliability
non_functional_requirements.description: Ensure the application is reliable and available.
acceptance_criteria: The application must achieve 99.9% uptime over a 30-day period.
Failover mechanisms must be in place to handle server failures.
The application must recover from failures within 5 minutes.

non_functional_requirements.title: Usability

non_functional_requirements.metric: Usability test score of 80% or higher.
acceptance_criteria: The application must pass usability testing with a score of 80% or higher.
User feedback must be collected and addressed in the design phase.

project.name: Banking Application Modernization
project.objective: Modernize a legacy VB6 banking application to C#, ensuring functionality is documented, architecture is designed, services are rewritten, and the application is deployed for Docker testing.

recommended_strategy.rationale: Readiness is relatively high; controlled translation with remediation and equivalence testing is viable.

phases.outcome: Capture golden flows and baseline outputs.

phases.outcome: Migrate forms/modules with dependency risk controls.

phases.title: Hardening and release evidence
phases.outcome: Finalize quality gates and publish evidence pack.

blocking.question: Target UI framework selection for migrated forms
blocking.default_recommendation: WinForms for lowest event-model delta from VB6 unless UX redesign is in scope.
blocking.impact_if_wrong: High rework risk in form/event parity and control migration.

blocking.question: ActiveX/OCX replacement strategy by dependency
blocking.default_recommendation: Replace common controls and isolate only high-risk dependencies behind adapters.
blocking.impact_if_wrong: Runtime regressions and release delays from unresolved control behavior.

blocking.question: Database contract strategy during migration
blocking.default_recommendation: Preserve contracts initially and modernize behind a compatibility layer.
blocking.impact_if_wrong: Business rule drift and data-side regressions.

blocking.question: Are there existing operational constraints or integration dependencies not listed?
blocking.default_recommendation: Resolve with product/business owner before implementation commitment.

non_blocking.question: Logging and observability stack for migrated runtime
non_blocking.default_recommendation: OpenTelemetry + structured logs for parity troubleshooting.

in_scope: Preserve legacy business behavior and workflows

Traceability from requirements to tests and evidence artifacts

items.title: Database Connection Service
items.outcome: Implement a C# service to establish a connection to the Access database using a modern data access library.
acceptance_criteria: The service must connect to the Access database using a specified connection string.
The service must handle connection errors gracefully and log them.
The service must be testable independently using unit tests.

items.title: Customer Data Command Service
items.outcome: Develop a service to interact with the 'customer' table in the database, replacing the legacy Command1 functionality.
acceptance_criteria: The service must execute CRUD operations on the 'customer' table.
The service must validate input data before executing database commands.
The service must log all database interactions for audit purposes.

items.title: User Interface Modernization
items.outcome: Redesign the user interface in C# to replicate the existing VB6 forms and workflows.
acceptance_criteria: The new UI must replicate the functionality of Form1 and Form5.
The UI must be responsive and compatible with modern browsers.
The UI must pass usability testing with a minimum score of 80% satisfaction.

items.title: Security and QA Checks
items.outcome: Implement security and quality assurance checks for the modernized application.
acceptance_criteria: The application must pass all security checks with no critical vulnerabilities.
The application must achieve a minimum of 90% code coverage in unit tests.
All identified bugs must be resolved before deployment.

items.title: Docker Deployment
items.outcome: Deploy the modernized application in a local Docker environment for testing.
acceptance_criteria: The application must run successfully in a Docker container.
The Docker image must be built using a specified Dockerfile.
Deployment scripts must automate the setup and teardown of the Docker environment.

items.title: Documentation of Functionality
items.outcome: Document the current and modernized functionality of the application.
acceptance_criteria: All existing functionalities must be documented with clear descriptions.
The documentation must include acceptance criteria for each functionality.
The documentation must be reviewed and approved by the project stakeholders.

items.title: Error Handling Implementation
items.outcome: Implement comprehensive error handling across all services.
acceptance_criteria: All services must handle exceptions and log errors appropriately.
Error messages must be user-friendly and provide actionable information.
The error handling strategy must be documented and reviewed.

items.title: Logging and Monitoring
items.outcome: Implement logging and monitoring for the modernized application.
acceptance_criteria: All services must log key events and errors to a centralized logging system.
Monitoring dashboards must provide real-time insights into application performance.
Alerts must be configured for critical failures and performance issues.

items.title: Performance
items.outcome: Ensure the application performs efficiently under expected load.
acceptance_criteria: The application must handle 1000 concurrent users without performance degradation.
Performance tests must show response times under 200ms for 95% of requests.
The application must pass load testing with a minimum throughput of 500 transactions per second.

items.title: Security
items.outcome: Ensure the application is secure against common vulnerabilities.
acceptance_criteria: The application must pass OWASP Top 10 security checks.
All data must be encrypted in transit and at rest.
Access controls must be implemented to restrict unauthorized access.

items.title: Scalability
items.outcome: Design the application to scale horizontally.
acceptance_criteria: The architecture must support horizontal scaling with minimal configuration changes.
The application must maintain performance metrics when scaled to 10,000 users.
Scalability tests must demonstrate the application's ability to scale efficiently.

items.title: Reliability
items.outcome: Ensure the application is reliable and available.
acceptance_criteria: The application must achieve 99.9% uptime over a 30-day period.
Failover mechanisms must be in place to handle server failures.
The application must recover from failures within 5 minutes.

items.title: Usability
items.outcome: Ensure the application is user-friendly and intuitive.
acceptance_criteria: The application must pass usability testing with a score of 80% or higher.
User feedback must be collected and addressed in the design phase.
The UI must be consistent and intuitive across all screens.

principles: Preserve critical legacy behavior first; modernization must prove functional equivalence.
